translation:
And I will make you ⟨into⟩ a bare rock, a spreading-out of fishing-nets. You shall not be rebuilt anymore, for I, YHWH, have spoken ⟨it⟩ — ⟨is⟩ the oracle of Adonai YHWH. 

*Note: The mem (מ) at the center of חֲרָמִים (fishing-nets) is the exact geometric center of the 74,499 letters of Ezekiel (position 37,249). The book that opens by a river (1:1) carries the water-letter at its structural core, inside the word for nets spread by the sea.*
